boundaries.evidence: Definition: on an empty variety the supplied BM groups are zero; the empty product of groups is the trivial group.

Definition: with a trivial group the group-dimension shift is zero, recovering ordinary Borel–Moore homology. No quotient-stack operation is presumed by this definition.
Definition: zero block ranks are omitted in induced presentations; the subsequent comparison lemma establishes their independence.
